messages:
maria: Opening a tiny docs PR — cleaning up model metadata labels (variant -> tier), adding benchmark numbers, and an SDK usage example for the new labeling. Need someone to sanity-check compatibility notes for long-context fallbacks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432

jonathan: Quick question — where do we want the bench numbers to live? model page bench table or top-level catalog summary?

alex: I can handle the YAML metadata change. Will add a migration note in the model folder and update the registry mapping. ETA today.

rachel: For long-context behavior we should show an explicit SDK example for setting max_context/sequence. Also call out seq-ceiling fallback and performance impact. Example:

```
# python SDK snippet
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate(model="nebula-3b", input="...", max_context=8192)
```

sam: Bench numbers from my run: 350 tokens/sec @ a100-40GB (fp16 quant), 120 t/s single-thread. Raw logs uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/bench-logs-432

kevin: Heads-up: we renamed internal variant labels. Runtime routing will need to translate old labels for a short deprecation period. I can add a note and a 2-week redirect rule.

docs-bot: PR opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432
Checklist auto-generated: [x] metadata update, [ ] bench table, [ ] SDK snippet, [ ] migration guide stub, [ ] redirect rule

maria: Thanks — @alex can you add the migration guide stub under /models/nebula-3b/CHANGELOG.md? @rachel can you review the SDK snippet for accuracy? I'll drop sam's bench numbers into the table once alex adds the metadata flags.

alex: :thumbsup: will do. Also adding a short note about label rename (variant->tier) and example mapping:

```
variant: "prod"  -> tier: "stable"
variant: "canary" -> tier: "canary"
```

rachel: I'll review today and comment inline. Also recommend a small note: "If your workload relies on old labels, set routing.alias = true for 14 days." 

sam: added a short summary row to the bench sheet. Link: https://sheets.google.com/bench-summary-432

kevin: I'll coordinate with infra to add the routing alias for 14 days and then remove. Will post RU once done.

maria: Goal: merge by EOD tomorrow. If anyone wants to pair on migration guide ping me.

alex: Updated the PR with YAML and guide stub.

docs-bot: PR status: merge-ready — all required checks passed except docs-preview which is queued.

maria: great, thanks everyone — leaving a note to ops to watch runtimes tomorrow morning.
